Generic sad shayari or broad family emotional topics underperformed. Overall confidence is moderate due to a limited sample size.

winning_patterns.evidence: Top performing videos are 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,666 views) and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,246 views).
